newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Rashid denies injection into DCB.
newsitem.headline: Rashid denies injection into DCB.

text.p: Rashid Hussain Holdings Bhd on Friday denied speculation that the stockbroking group was going to be injected into banking concern DCB Holdings Bhd.
But Rashid's chairman Abdul Rashid Hussain said his company was open to the proposal of being merged with other banks if it was found to be suitable.
"There are no formal proposals being made," he told a news conference after the company's annual meeting. "If it is suitable, no doubt I will do it."
Rashid has been speculated to be involved in a share swap with DCB. Rashid currently owns a 20.8 percent stake in DCB.
Abdul Rashid said the company was looking at many proposals when asked on speculation that U.S. investment bank Morgan Stanley was taking a stake in the company.
Rashid and DCB stocks have been rising in active trade in the last few weeks on rumoured restructuring of the two groups.
Around 0350 GMT, Rashid stock was up 20 cents to 15.60 ringgit, and DCB rose 30 to 9.05.
